GOALS is an Erasmus Mundus master in the governance and administration of leisure and sports, run by five European universities from Lille to Lisbon and Lunex. The self-funded campaign for the fifth cohort closed on 15 May 2026, and the next application campaign — including any scholarship round — will be announced on the programme's pages.

Programme Highlights

  • Five-university consortium specialising in sport and active-leisure governance
  • Cohort-5 self-funded round closed 15 May 2026; next campaign pending
  • Teaching across France, Portugal, Lithuania, Poland and Luxembourg
  • Careers in sport federations, event governance and public leisure policy

Who Should Apply

Sport science, law, economics, management and public administration graduates with sport-sector interest are the intended cohort.

Funding and Costs

Participation costs and any scholarship places are described on the programme's costs-and-scholarships page each cycle. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Follow the GOALS how-to-apply page for the next campaign announcement and review the participation-cost structure early. Key deadline information: Self-funded campaign for the fifth cohort closed 15 May 2026; the next campaign will be announced on the official page.
